title: Vancouver, WA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Vancouver, WA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Vancouver is a city in WA with a population of 190,000. Washington’s oldest city across the Columbia from Portland with no income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year.
